gold.correction: annotation.alternative_syllables; exact match against any listed alternative

baseline.detector: flag current_syllable iff observed as erroneous in train
baseline.corrector: most frequent train gold alternative for current_syllable; lexical tie broken Unicode codepoint order
baseline.dev_use: none; fixed baseline has no tuned threshold

uncertainty: nonparametric bootstrap 2000 resamples over test sentences, seed 6801, 95% percentile CI
adjudication: PASS only within this spelling-stratum/baseline envelope if evidence complete; no open-domain or full ErrorFamily inference
